display_long_description:
The sanctuary has fallen, and its guardians have turned. Descend three floors of ruined halls, frozen crypts and burning sanctums, armed with the spells in your hands.

**Your hands are the spellbook.** Conjure a fireball and throw it like a real ball. Freeze an enemy in ice, then shatter it with fire. Grab a goblin with telekinesis and fling it into a wall, a pit or a rack of spikes.

**Combine everything.** Volatile crystals, falling stones, braziers you can tip over: every room has its own hazards, and the best kills are the ones you set up.

**A different descent every time.** Choose your path through glowing doors to rewards, healing, elites or challenge rooms. After each fight, pick one of three boons that change how your spells behave. Each floor ends with a guardian.

**Keep growing.** Hex Shards earned in every run, win or lose, buy permanent upgrades. Achievements unlock run modifiers and glove styles.

**Ways to play:** the full three-floor Run, a quick Trial, a seeded Daily, and the Spell Lab sandbox.

**Comfortable your way:** seated or standing, smooth movement or teleport, snap turning, an optional vignette, left- or right-handed spells and Story / Normal / Hard difficulty.

Single-player. No internet connection needed. No ads, no in-app purchases.
